chapter: The Making of the Constitution (Framing the Constitution)
questionText:
Arrange the following milestones in the making of the Indian Constitution in chronological sequence:
I. First inaugural sitting of the Constituent Assembly
II. Jawaharlal Nehru moves the Objectives Resolution
III. Constituent Assembly formally adopts and enacts the Constitution
IV. The Constitution of India comes into full legal force
(A) I
(B) II
(C) III
(D) IV

Choose the correct chronological sequence from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
1. Chronology: First sitting (9 Dec 1946) -> Objectives Resolution (13 Dec 1946) -> Constitution adopted (26 Nov 1949) -> Full enforcement (26 Jan 1950).
Hence, Option A is correct.
Hence, option (D) is correct.
